maddeler.e:
اسلنطحت (form IIIq)
# اِسْلَنْطَحْتُ (islanṭaḥtu) /is.lan.tˤaħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
# اِسْلَنْطَحْتَ (islanṭaḥta) /is.lan.tˤaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
# اِسْلَنْطَحْتِ (islanṭaḥti) /is.lan.tˤaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
# اِسْلَنْطَحَتْ (islanṭaḥat)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
